full_judgment: 7. The judgment impugned before the High Court Division was the judgment of reversal. Therefore, it was incumbent Upon it to see whether the Appellate Court, was justified in setting aside the judgment and decree of the trial Court and sending the suit back to it for fresh trial. From the judgment of the Appellate Court, it further appears that since it sent the suit back to the trial Court for fresh trial, it, in fact, did not discuss the evidence in detail and did not come to any definite finding as to the issues involved in the suit. Therefore, it was more obligatory upon the High Court Division to see whether the trial Court was justified in decreeing the suit in view of the pleading of the party and the evidence adduced by them. But unfortunately, the High Court Division did not do that and as stated hereinbefore, it without applying its mind and considering the evidence on record just set aside judgment and decree of the Appellate Court and restored those of the trial Court. And thereby the High Court Division filed to exercise the power vested in it under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure.
